summary: The root جبل (jbl) primarily refers to a large company or multitude of people. It can also denote a nation or people.
lane: جِبِلٌّ جبل and and [accord. to the CK like عَدْلٌ , but correctly like عِدْلٌ ,] and and , (S, K,) accord. to different readings of the instance occurring in the Kur xxxvi. 62, the first being the reading of the people of ElMedeeneh, (S,) [and the most common,] A great company of men; as also and : (K:) or [simply] a company of men; (S;) as also , accord. to Kh; (Sgh, TA;) and so and and : which last three signify also the same as أُمَّةٌ [ a nation, or people, &c.]: (K:) it is said [by some] that جِبِلٌّ is pl. [or coll. gen. n.] of meaning a numerous company: (TA:) جِبَلَةٌ is pl. of : one says, قَبَحَ ٱللّٰهُ جِبَلَتَكُمْ [ May God remove far from prosperity, or success, ] your companies: (Fr, TA:) and جِبَلٌ is pl. of . (Bd in xxxvi. 62.)
